data.heading: Week 1 (13 Feb - 19 Feb 2026):
data.text: -  No  significant  change  in  minimum  temperatures  likely  over  Northwest,  Northeast  India and Madhya Pradesh for next 3 days and gradual rise by 2-3 ° C during subsequent 4 days.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over Karnataka, Kerala & Mahe and Konkan & Goa and gradual rise by about 2 ° C for subsequent days.
-  Hot and Humid conditions likely over Coastal Karnataka and Konkan & Goa.

data.heading: Week 2 (20 Feb - 26 Feb 2026):
data.text:
-  Minimum temperatures are likely to rise gradually by 2-3°C over most parts of the country.
-  Minimum temperatures  are  likely  to  be  above  normal  (by  2-4°C)  over  most  parts  of  the country except East India, where they are likely to be below normal by 2-4°C.
-  Maximum temperatures  are  likely  to  be  above  normal  (by  2-4°C)  over  most  parts  of  the country  except  central  &  adjoining  peninsular  India,  where  they  are  likely  to  be  below normal by 1-3°C.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice: About 12.80 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 13.16 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses: About 0.58 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 0.50 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds: About  0.99  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  0.59  lakh  ha during the corresponding period of last year.
